blocks.title: Local setup, incremental CI, and Lighthouse backpressure
blocks.code:
bash tools/checkout-native.sh
zig build --fetch
scripts/smthrs ci '//...'
node tools/audit_report.mjs --run
# Attach your agent via one-time-use Smithers Cloud MCP auth:
node tools/sandbox_auth.mjs --mode attach

cards.title: Run freely on your machine or fork
cards.text: Non-maintainers are encouraged to run tests, fuzzers, and Uphill audits locally. Trunk cache writes and required merge gates stay isolated to controlled sandboxes.
cards.label: Untrusted encouraged

cards.title: Start with a failing fixture or test
cards.text: Add the smallest failing Zig unit test, execution-apis transcript, or Lean property before changing production code.
cards.label: Repro first

cards.title: Keep every audit score moving up
cards.text: Run uphill and node tools/audit_report.mjs to check safety, style, verification, conformance, docs, and factory hygiene before opening a change.
cards.label: Lighthouse backpressure

cards.title: Connect via MCP, humans merge
cards.text: Agents interact over https://smithers.sh/evmts/zevm/mcp using one-time-use attach tokens. Only maintainers approve and merge.
cards.label: Human merge gate

blocks.title: ZEVM
blocks.tagline: Embeddable Zig Ethereum execution and proof-backed light-client node with C ABI, Node-API, WASM, and a Lean 4 formal spec.
blocks.text: Powered by pinned Voltaire cryptography and Guillotine Mini execution with zero JavaScript EVM dependencies, built and verified continuously on Smithers Cloud.

announcement.label: v0.1.0 native Zig engine: Fusaka/Osaka EIPs, Lean 4 spec (140k diff-fuzz cases, 0 divergences), ExEx + Rebase Fork

blocks.title: Embed ZEVM in Node.js (zero JS EVM)

cards.title: Local dev and fork node
cards.text: Deterministic accounts, snapshots, mining controls, Hardhat console.log capture, ExEx event streams, and rebase forks.
cards.label: Trusted mode

cards.title: Proof-backed consensus reads
cards.text: Beacon sync-committee BLS verification and MPT state proofs anchored to baked checkpoints for Mainnet, Sepolia, Holesky, and Hoodi.
cards.label: Light mode

cards.title: Modern hardfork coverage
cards.text: EIP-7951 P256VERIFY, EIP-7825 gas cap, EIP-7934 block size cap, EIP-7892 BPO blobs, EIP-7918 reserve, EIP-7594 PeerDAS, and EIP-7910 eth_config.
cards.label: Fusaka & Osaka

cards.title: Lean 4 spec and 30 fuzz targets
cards.text: Zero-sorry Lean 4 reference spec differentially fuzzed against Zig alongside 14 property suites and Hive rpc-compat transcripts.
cards.label: Formal verification

cards.title: C ABI, Node-API, and Browser WASM
cards.text: Call one verified Zig engine from C, Rust, Go, Node.js, or browsers through include/zevm.h and @evmts/zevm.
cards.label: Embeddable

cards.title: Public backpressure and shared cache
cards.text: Incremental smthrs CI backed by build.smithers.sh, public Lighthouse audit reports, Obsidian wiki, and authenticated MCP.
cards.label: Smithers Factory

cards.title: @evmts/zevm
cards.text: Prebuilt native N-API addons for 11 targets plus browser WASM backend with zero JavaScript EVM dependencies.
cards.label: npm

cards.title: evmts/voltaire
cards.text: Pinned Zig Ethereum primitives, RLP, ABI, Keccak, secp256k1, BLS12-381, BN254, and KZG cryptography.
cards.label: Primitives

cards.title: evmts/guillotine-mini
cards.text: Spec-compliant Zig EVM interpreter plugged behind ZEVM's evm_backend seam.
cards.label: Execution

cards.title: include/zevm.h
cards.text: Stable C ABI for embedding trusted dev nodes and verified light clients in any host language.
cards.label: C Header

cards.title: Lighthouse Backpressure
cards.text: Live Uphill scorecards across safety, style, verification, Ethereum conformance, docs, and factory trust.
cards.label: Audit UI

cards.title: Smithers Cloud MCP
cards.text: Public Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint for agents to inspect code, docs, flows, issues, and PRs.
cards.label: Agent API
